name: Jibaku Kanojo ~Kanojo wa Kakurete Mimodaeru~
original_name: 自爆カノジョ ～彼女は隠れて身悶える～
source:
“How much do you love me?”

It’s been a week since Kazuya started going out with his first love and classmate Asa. It was the first time he had dated someone, so even such a simple question left him at a loss for words and blushing profusely. She would come up close to him suddenly and stare at him, knowing very well that he would feel embarrassed. He felt like she was doing it just to get a strange reaction out of him, but it was because she thought he was cute when he was flustered. She wanted to see more of it, while he was determined to do the same to her in return.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/12/24/december-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
“你有多爱我？”

距离和也开始和他的初恋兼同学麻一起出去已经一周了。他还是第一次跟人约会，这么简单的问题，他都说不出话来，脸红得厉害。她会突然靠近他，盯着他看，她很清楚他会感到尴尬。他觉得她这么做只是为了让他有奇怪的反应，但那是因为她觉得他慌乱的时候很可爱。她想看到更多，而他也决心对她做同样的事情作为回报。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/12/24/december-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
